Offline calorie tracking for iPhone, without an account.

QikCal is an iPhone food diary with its searchable food library included in the app. After installation, search foods, set a portion, and log a meal without an internet connection.

Want to try food search before buying? Search the food library and estimate a portion in your browser. The paid iPhone app adds offline meal logging and an on-device diary.

One-time purchase · iPhone · iOS 17 or later

The food library and your diary live on the iPhone, so ordinary food search and logging do not depend on a server.

Your food diary stays on your iPhone.

QikCal has no account, advertising SDK, analytics SDK, or server diary. Your food log is excluded from device backups. Settings lets you export or delete it.

This release does not sync a diary between devices. You need an internet connection to download the app and receive App Store updates; after installation, food search and logging work offline.

Read the privacy policy · See food data, sources, and estimate limits

A few practical questions.

Does it work without internet?Yes, after installation. The food library and diary are available on the iPhone; downloading and App Store updates require a connection.

Does it sync across devices?No. This release keeps the diary on one iPhone and does not include account or cloud sync.

Are calorie values exact?No. They are estimates tied to specific food records. Portions, ingredients, and preparation can change a meal's actual nutrition.

QikCal is a food diary for general reference, not medical advice. For nutrition guidance about a medical condition, consult a qualified healthcare professional.
